purpose: Refresh the stale international DSH STORE from the already merged and validated GitHub Pages artifact.

connection.hostKeyPolicy: StrictHostKeyChecking; host key already present in known_hosts

remoteMutation.installMethod: Download deploy/refresh-from-pages.sh from the immutable merged Commit, verify SHA-256 0a1e6fc0a78f49d0914662c943d594bd639be844c605c4fe0a6126b90f224d5d, copy the verified old script to backupPath, then atomically replace the installed script.
remoteMutation.expectedBehavior: Request gzip for bounded fixed-source artifacts, retry from byte zero, preserve release-manifest SHA-256 validation, reuse unchanged files, and switch the current symlink atomically.
remoteMutation.backup: The refresh service creates a release backup with relative-path SHA-256 manifest before switching.
remoteMutation.rollback: On health failure the script restores the previous current symlink and rechecks health. If script installation fails, restore the backed-up script using a same-filesystem temporary file and atomic rename.

gates: Re-fetch GitHub main and confirm it remains at the planned base before creating the branch.
Run npm run check and git diff --check for the exact one-file plan change.
Open a CI-checked PR and merge only after all required checks pass.
Immediately before remote mutation, recheck server ID, exact environment, installed script hash, current release path and manifest hash, and backup-path absence.
Install only the immutable merged script after its SHA-256 matches the plan.
Run the existing international systemd refresh unit.
Verify unit success, release-manifest source Commit, all artifact hashes, public health paths, and exact public Catalog/detail hashes.
healthCheck: The international systemd unit succeeds; /opt/dsh-store/current points to a release whose manifest names source Commit 4a05f7259bdbec201fb8d5a05a960d86b13e1402 and whose files match every manifest hash; HTTPS health paths pass; dsh.store Catalog, index, and both details match expectedPublicHashes.

rollback.site: Script-managed atomic current-symlink rollback to the exact prior release, preserving the generated backup.
rollback.script: Restore the exact old script from backupPath with a verified hash and atomic rename.
rollback.authorContactState: No author contact or ledger changes.
